title: Reserve functional face regions with loop cuts before feature extrusion
preconditions: the target begins as a continuous box-like quad mesh
the required feature positions are known from the design or reference
the selected edge ring traverses only the intended quad region
action_policy: Place only the loop cuts needed to create later-selectable functional regions.
Select the resulting faces and inset or extrude them from the same mesh; do not substitute touching mesh primitives when the surface should be continuous.
Keep finishing modifiers live and unapplied; inspect the base cage and evaluated result separately.
failure_predicates: the candidate ring does not traverse a continuous quad route
new cuts are generic density rather than supporting an identified feature
the result becomes disconnected, non-manifold, or requires an applied modifier to read correctly
recovery: choose fewer or differently placed rings

planner_hint.reason: The verified lesson and two controlled Blender constructions show that planned loop cuts create the exact face regions needed for later feature operations without primitive assembly.
planner_hint.expected_effect: Create an explicitly planned, selectable quad region for the next feature operation.
verification: confirm the cut traverses only the selected quad ring
confirm the planned face region exists
inspect base manifoldness and evaluated modifier result

sources.description: The chair blockout places cuts only to provide the leg and back face regions needed before extrusion.

runtime_usage.summary: The skill ranked first for a matching planned-region ticket; the planner selected loop_cut_selection and a typed transaction committed two cuts without manifold regression.

version_scope: Blender 5.2 LTS transfer; source lesson is Blender 2.80
status_note: Frame-and-speech verified episode, reproduction, different-geometry transfer, and one fresh planner-guided typed runtime use are complete.
